Maria C.: Heads up — we're seeing a corruption pattern in the payment-events table in prod, need to fetch a small sample snapshot for triage. Requesting 1-hour elevated DB read access to run a scoped `pg_dump --table=payment_events --where='created_at > now() - interval \"2 hours\"'` :eyes:
Alex R.: +1 on needing the sample. We only need ~50 rows, can gzip and drop PII before sharing. Will redact `user_email` and `billing_address` fields locally and push to our internal S3 redaction bucket.
Jonah (oncall): tagging @security-oncall for JIT approval. Can you confirm scope: read-only, no writes, and audit logging enabled?
security-oncall: Ack. Please include the justification and exact commands here. We require a break-glass ticket and an approver. Also confirm a timebox and who will run the dump.
Maria C.: Justification: urgent triage for a regression causing duplicate charges in the last 2 hours. Command I'll run from jumpbox: `PGHOST=prod-db-1 PGUSER=ro_dbt PGDATABASE=redwood psql -c "COPY (SELECT id, created_at, amount, user_email, billing_address FROM payment_events WHERE created_at > now() - interval '2 hours' LIMIT 50) TO STDOUT WITH CSV" > sample.csv`
Maria C.: Timebox: 1 hour. I'll run, redact `user_email`/`billing_address` locally with a small python script, upload gzip to `s3://redwood-internal/redact-triage/1951234567/` and then delete local copies.
Alex R.: I can supervise and verify the redaction step. We'll strip out the two fields and replace with hashes.
security-oncall: Quick checklist: 1) Limited to ro user 2) Run from approved jumpbox 3) Record session in the break-glass ticket 4) Upload to designated bucket with server-side encryption 5) Notify security once done. If all true, I can approve 1-hour ephemeral elevation.
Maria C.: All items true. Using `jumpbox-prod-2`, ro user only, will start a `script` session for capture and attach to ticket 4872.
security-oncall: Approved for 60 minutes. Generating ephemeral creds now — audit-bot will post the token (do NOT paste token in channel).
audit-bot: Ephemeral access record created. Request ID: AR-2026-1951234567. Duration: 60m. Operator: Maria C. Session logging: enabled.
Jonah (oncall): Great — Maria, please paste the break-glass ticket link and tag me when upload is complete so I can run quick checksum and confirm redaction before we share with product.
Maria C.: Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFR-4872. Will ping here once upload is on S3 and include S3 path + object checksum. Thanks! :pray:
security-oncall: Reminder: keep copies only until postmortem finished, then delete. We'll review logs tomorrow in the security standup.
Alex R.: If you need a scripted redactor snippet:```
import csv, hashlib
with open('sample.csv') as inf, open('sample_redacted.csv', 'w') as outf:
    r = csv.reader(inf)
    w = csv.writer(outf)
    for row in r:
        row[3] = hashlib.sha256(row[3].encode()).hexdigest()  # user_email
        row[4] = '<REDACTED>'  # billing_address
        w.writerow(row)
```
Maria C.: Upload complete to s3://redwood-internal/redact-triage/1951234567/sample_redacted.csv.gz. md5: d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e. Tagged Jonah and security-oncall.
Jonah (oncall): Verified redaction fields not present, checksum matches. Closing loop with payments team. Thanks team.
security-oncall: Confirmed audit logs show session and commands executed. Locking ephemeral creds. Please attach audit record to the ticket. :white_check_mark:
